claims: Eid prayers are performed on Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha.
Eid prayers are performed shortly after sunrise.
Eid prayers are typically performed in open spaces or mosques.
Eid prayers consist of two rak'ats.
Eid prayers include extra takbeers.
Eid prayers are followed by a khutbah.
Muslim Hands UK and Islamic Relief Worldwide say it is Sunnah to perform ghusl before attending Eid prayers.
Muslim Hands UK and Islamic Relief Worldwide say it is Sunnah to wear fine clothes before attending Eid prayers.
Muslim Hands UK and Islamic Relief Worldwide say it is Sunnah to eat before attending Eid prayers.
Eid prayer time is after sunrise and before Zuhr.
Eid prayers are performed in congregation.
In the first rak'ah of Eid prayer, 3 or 7 extra takbeers are recited after the opening takbeer depending on school of thought.
In the second rak'ah of Eid prayer, 3 or 5 extra takbeers are recited before ruku.
Khutbah is delivered after Eid prayer.
It is Sunnah to recite the Takbeerat 'Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, La ilaha illallah...' while traveling to the Eid prayer location.
Eid prayer involves making niyyah to pray 2 raka’at Eid salah.
In the first rakah of Eid prayer, opening takbeer is 'Allahu Akbar' followed by 3–7 additional takbeers.
In the first rakah of Eid prayer, Surah Al-Fatiha and another Surah are recited loudly.
The first rakah of Eid prayer is completed with ruku and sajdah.
In the second rakah of Eid prayer, it starts with 3–5 additional takbeers.
In the second rakah of Eid prayer, Al-Fatiha and another Surah are recited.
The second rakah of Eid prayer is completed with ruku, sajdah, and final Tashahhud/Salam.
Eid prayers can be performed at home with family if one cannot attend a mosque.
